cognitive_contract.label: Apply (Direct application)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Execute a known model, algorithm, relation, or procedure under the right conditions.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Leave one meaningful identification, relation, translation, or execution decision to the learner; support may make the surrounding route explicit.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Narrow the immediate operation if useful, but do not perform W.

slots.X: the givens and conditions that determine whether the known procedure or relation is valid here
slots.Y: a demonstrated procedure or relation together with its applicability conditions
slots.Z: instantiate and execute the known procedure correctly
slots.W: the decisive substitution, transformation, or execution step that yields the requested result
slots.wrong_idea: a familiar formula or procedure is executed without checking its conditions or mapping variables correctly
slots.replacement_rule: verify applicability, map each given to the procedure, then execute
slots.visual_job: align givens with procedure variables or steps without carrying out the protected computation
slots.check_job: verify by units, substitution-back, a special value, inverse operation, or an alternate computation

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact question stem requiring execution of standard procedure/algorithm
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 procedural orientation, H2 intermediate execution setup; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; step-by-step why-valid execution with independent verification
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific computational slip or sign error

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters or answers in Core 1A text

core2a_supported_practice.crux_alignment: Identical procedural crux with progressive hints and after-commit unit link
core2a_supported_practice.navigation: Data attribute data-core-unit-id binding to specific topic unit

core2b_transfer.perturbation_rule: Vary numerical parameters or coordinate frame while testing the exact procedure
core2b_transfer.verification: Confirm learner procedural execution W transferred without rote answer matching

rules.T01_PRECOMMIT_OPTION_STYLING: Pre-commit option styling must not disclose the keyed answer via green borders, classes, or attributes
rules.T02_SUMMARY_ANSWER_LEAK: Summary elements must not disclose the answer letter or key prior to attempt commitment
rules.T03_SOLUTION_PRECOMMIT_UNLOCKED: Solution container must be inert and hidden prior to learner commitment
rules.T04_SCORE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: Difficulty score must be within [0, 2] for Band D1
rules.T05_CRUX_MOVE_REF_MISSING: Question must declare a valid crux_move reference
rules.T06_KATEX_RENDER_DEFECT: HTML must not contain KaTeX error spans or unescaped macro issues
rules.T07_CORE1A_PARAMETER_LEAK: Core 1A declarative study must not leak Core 2 specific question parameters or answers
rules.T08_CORE1B_PRECOMMIT_ANSWER_LEAK: Core 1B reconstruction must enforce answer_before_attempt: FORBIDDEN
rules.T09_CORE2A_UNIT_NAV_MISSING: Core 2A must provide explicit question-specific unit navigation
rules.T10_EMPTY_HINT: Hints must provide meaningful question-specific guidance
rules.T11_PRECOMMIT_PROTECTED_W_LEAK: Pre-commit hints must not leak protected work W (the decisive execution step/result)
rules.T12_CORE_P2_TOPIC_ONLY_NO_QUESTION_UNIT: HTML must target a source-declared question-specific Core1 unit
rules.T13_HINT_PROGRESSIVE_SEQUENCE_MISSING: Hint sequence must progress from H1 conceptual nudge to H2 tactical step
rules.T14_SOURCE_CUSTODY_INTEGRITY: Source question must maintain verified provenance and custody hash
